correctness.rationale: In the residual plane let v=Ar/‖Ar‖ and write r/‖r‖=cv+sw. For Gram diagonal entry a and off-diagonal d in this basis the normal equation leaves s(w−(d/a)v), after normalization. If s=0 the residual is eliminated. The embedding gives (a−1)²+d²≤ε², and (1−ε²)d²≤ε²a² since the difference in the relaxed scalar inequality is (a−(1−ε²))². Equality is feasible: the displayed M± has trace 2 and eigenvalues 1±ε, hence a real square root. The SPD moment bound ‖Ar‖²≤(L+μ)〈r,Ar〉−μL for unit r follows spectrally; minimizing the lower bound on c² gives c≥2√(μL)/(μ+L) with equality at the stated endpoint-eigenvector mixture. This proves sharpness over the admissible class (not for each fixed matrix or for d=1). Combining produces the exact factor, with one-step elimination when κ=1. For κ>1 the uniform strict condition is exactly ε<c_*=2√κ/(κ+1); at ε=c_* the negative extremal off-diagonal has d/a=−c_*/s, forcing t=0. The same sketch also meets all larger budgets; reusing it is admissible on the unchanged plane and stagnates. Below threshold the bound iterates for adaptive admissible sketches. The exact-rational support checker was inspected, not run; its bounded tests are corroborative only.
